interfaces.name: elementFeatures
interfaces.note: Preserve formal_target.lean lines 9–15 exactly in meaning.
interfaces.summary: Exact feature set assigned to each of the five elements.

interfaces.name: coverage
interfaces.note: `coverage (s : Finset Element) : ℝ` equals the card of `s.biUnion elementFeatures` coerced to ℝ.
interfaces.summary: Real-valued cardinality of the union of features covered by a selected finite set.

interfaces.name: marginal
interfaces.note: Preserve the exact `Fin 5 → ℝ` marginal values.

interfaces.name: expectedCoverage
interfaces.note: `expectedCoverage (θ : Weight) : ℝ := ∑ s, θ s * coverage s`.
interfaces.summary: Expected coverage for arbitrary real weights over all subsets.

interfaces.name: MarginalFeasible
interfaces.note: Keep θ : Weight arbitrary real-valued and express nonnegativity as a predicate.
interfaces.summary: Nonnegative normalized weights with the exact prescribed singleton marginals.

interfaces.name: PairwiseFeasible
interfaces.note: Preserve exact equality to `marginal i * marginal j` and all universal indices.
interfaces.summary: Marginal feasibility plus exact prescribed pair moments for every ordered pair i < j.

interfaces.name: IsUnrestrictedOptimum
interfaces.note: Preserve the existential witness and universal bound conjuncts.
interfaces.summary: Attainment plus universal upper bound over all marginal-feasible real weights.

interfaces.name: IsPairwiseUpperBound
interfaces.note: Preserve both nonemptiness and the universal bound over arbitrary Weight.
interfaces.summary: Nonempty pairwise-feasible domain plus universal expected-coverage upper bound.

interfaces.name: coverage_monotone
interfaces.note: Conclusion shape: `∀ ⦃s t : Finset Element⦄, s ⊆ t → coverage s ≤ coverage t`; this is the first conjunct consumed by `finite_pairwise_coverage_gap`.
interfaces.summary: The explicit coverage function is monotone under Finset inclusion.

interfaces.name: coverage_submodular
interfaces.note: Conclusion shape: `∀ s t : Finset Element, coverage (s ∪ t) + coverage (s ∩ t) ≤ coverage s + coverage t`; preserve direction exactly for the second conjunct.
interfaces.summary: The explicit coverage function satisfies the union/intersection submodular inequality.

interfaces.name: Weight
interfaces.note: Implement as `abbrev Weight := Finset Element → ℝ`; do not restrict the type to nonnegative weights.
interfaces.summary: Arbitrary real-valued weights on every finite subset of Element.
